DEP_ANTACIDS_CALCIUM.note: Reclassified as monitoring rather than body-calcium depletion; retained the bounded carbonate/fracture evidence.

DEP_ANTICONVULSANTS_VITAMIND.note: Carbamazepine-specific meta-analysis supports the bounded claim.

DEP_ANTICONVULSANTS_VITAMINK.note: The later review does not support routine antenatal vitamin K, the signal is pregnancy-specific, and the runtime has no pregnancy context. A significant class-wide consumer warning would be a false positive outside pregnancy.
